title: A-long large-cap value-yield forward-PAPER capture accumulator
description: Output contract for the A-long forward-paper capture runner (the separate slice the reviewed prereg `a_long_large_cap_value_yield_forward_paper_tracking_20260609` authorizes). Holds the monthly-snapshot + backfill-as-mature accumulator for the 2 surviving research-only clues + the 1 promotion-eligible composite. **PAPER evidence only — NOT ship-gate, NOT alpha-validated, NOT real-money.** The frozen construction (universe / neutralization / basket / return / horizons) is NOT duplicated here — it lives in the prereg (single source); this artifact references it and records observed forward cohorts + per-construction metrics + the paper-read status. Per-monthly captures do NOT spend the singleton ledger; only the post-window promotion decision does (a separate reviewed artifact). The runner that writes this is commit-safe but execution-gated (each forward data pull needs its own user authorization). **draft-07 只能焊 shape/enum/promotion_role↔construction_id(if/then)/matured⟹非空(if/then)/horizon 键集(propertyNames)/每 construction 必含 504 horizon(required)/interim 集 const=[21,63,126,252]/symbol 唯一/每 block 恰 3 项(minItems+maxItems);跨字段/跨行不变式(read_available↔matured_cohort_count↔routing 的 promote/insufficient 门、primary==composite、no pre-start-floor cohort、cohort as_of 唯一、as_of_latest_capture==最新 cohort as_of、construction_metrics 与每 cohort 的 constructions 各恰好覆盖 3 冻结构造一次(无重/缺)、basket_size==selected_symbols 数、matured_cohort_count==实际 504-matured cohort 数、必备 source_refs 精确路径)由 `runners/a_long_large_cap_value_yield_forward_paper_capture.py::validate_accumulator_consistency` 在 Python 强制(write_accumulator schema 校验后调,fail-closed)** —— R-ALONG-VY-FP-ACCUMULATOR-SCHEMA-PROMOTION-GATE-GAP。

generated_at.description: provenance(自由串);PIT 由 as_of/各 cohort as_of 承担。

as_of_latest_capture.description: 最近一次 snapshot 的 month-end as_of(YYYYMMDD)。

source_refs.description: 至少含: 该 forward-paper prereg、其 ledger、被验证的 batch execution_summary、本 accumulator 设计。

frozen_construction_ref.description: 冻结构造(universe/neutralization/basket/return/horizons)的单一来源 = prereg;本 accumulator 不复制规则,只引用 + 记录观测。

interim_horizons_trading_days.description: 诊断早读,**精确等于冻结集 [21,63,126,252]**(const:order-sensitive,拒空/重复/未知/重排);非主判据。

cohorts.description: 每月 month-end as_of 一个 cohort(无 as_of < start_floor 计入)。snapshot 追加;backfill 随各 horizon 成熟回填。

as_of.description: month-end 决策日(last open A-share trading day of the month)。

universe_size.description: 该 as_of PIT 冻结的 top-500 候选数(可 < 500,真实 PIT)。

pit_source.description: 前向 = 决策当日 live 冻结(out-of-sample,无 look-ahead)。

constructions.description: 每 cohort 恰好 3 个构造行(2 单因子 + 1 合成;身份唯一/全覆盖由 validator 焊)。

basket_size.description: 选中篮子股数(top 20%,≥10;< 10 → 该月该构造跳过,basket_size=0)。

selected_symbols.description: 篮子成分(等权;provenance + backfill);唯一,数 == basket_size(跨字段由 validator 焊)。

entry_date.description: as_of 后第一个交易日收盘(建仓基准);算不出→null。

relative_excess_net.description: 篮子总收益(adj,扣 round-trip 0.0026)− 基准总收益;pending/缺数→null。

horizons.description: 键 ∈ 21/63/126/252/504(propertyNames 焊)。**决策(显式):主 horizon `504` 每 construction 必含**(required 焊,gate 判据);**interim 21/63/126/252 可选**(诊断早读,随各自成熟回填,缺=尚未到期/未回填,非违规)。matured ⟹ relative_excess_net 为数值 + exit_date/policy 非空(if/then 焊)。

construction_metrics.description: 每构造跨已成熟 monthly cohorts 的聚合(主判据 = 504d primary horizon vs CSI300)。恰好 3 行(每冻结构造一行;身份唯一/全覆盖由 validator 焊)。

matured_cohort_count.description: 504d 已成熟的 monthly cohort 数。

hac_t.description: Newey-West HAC t(月度 overlapping cohorts);< 阈值不构成 alpha 证明。

rolling_relative_nav_max_drawdown.description: 滚动相对净值最大回撤(负);tradeable 门 = ≥ -0.15。

persistence_positive.description: OOS 均超额是否持续为正(matured + interim 方向一致)。

primary_construction_id.description: 唯一可升级构造;2 单因子仅诊断,不得 best-of-three。

read_available.description: matured_cohort_count ≥ 12 才 true(否则 insufficient,不评)。

routing.description: 据 primary 构造的 OOS 持续性 + 回撤算出;promote_eligible **不授权真钱**,仅意味着可提一份新 reviewed real-money prereg。
